summary: Remote-controlled agent runner: paired WebRTC peers can drive shells and AI CLIs on the host
details: @factiii/runner is a headless daemon that pairs with Factiii web/mobile clients over WebRTC via api.factiii.com and lets paired peers run Claude/Codex agents on the host, driving shells, tmux, git, and native toolchains. The remote-control capability is the openly documented purpose of the package and is described in the README; the daemon starts only when the user explicitly runs `factiii-runner start` or installs a LaunchAgent/systemd unit, with no npm lifecycle hooks triggering it on install. Pairing uses a per-account JWT stored under ~/.factiii-runner/config.json, and the control plane is a hardcoded first-party endpoint (api.factiii.com). Blast radius is nonetheless full-host: any paired peer can execute arbitrary commands with the user's privileges, and the daemon will continue accepting work after the operator starts it until it is explicitly stopped. No installer-secret harvesting outside the package's own state directory, no install-time fetch-and-execute, no obfuscated or hidden second channel, and no exfiltration to a non-first-party destination are present in the shipped code.
